source: Written for this project, NOT AI Video Bootcamp material: what makes a frame read as an ordinary phone snapshot by a real person - the viral street-cat look - instead of a polished, cinema-camera render. Measured against a reference frame the user supplied (a street cat by an empty steel bowl, shot low on a phone, passers-by blurred behind).
note: Three parts, each its own Compose toggle. `snapshot`: with no shot chosen, the camera and lens come from prompt_bank.json's own `phone-candid` preset and the core pick skips its cinema words, then one 'who took it' line by subject kind is added. A chosen shot, typed shot, explicit camera or a film stock is a deliberate look and wins - nothing is narrowed and no phone line is added (except for the phone presets themselves). `backgrounds`: read from the Setting, one passer-by, one unrelated everyday thing and one worn surface, picked by seed; a studio or plain backdrop gets nothing. `moments`: a split second named by the Action, or a kind default by seed. All three land as non-layer overrides on the free tail, so they can only add to a realism score.

animal: a phone video frame taken by a passer-by who crouched down, the phone held low near the ground at the animal's eye level
a quick phone clip by someone who stopped to film it, the phone held low and slightly tilted
filmed on a phone from a few steps away by someone passing, held at knee height
human: a quick, unposed phone snapshot a friend took
a phone photo taken by a friend from across the table, an unplanned moment
a casual phone picture someone took on the spot, framed a little off
object: a casual phone photo taken from just above, the way someone shows a friend what they have
a quick phone picture taken where it sits, nothing moved for the shot
place: a phone photo taken while walking through, the frame slightly off level

snapshot.processing: slightly flat phone colours, everyday smartphone sharpening and processing

street.label: Street
passers: a passer-by's legs blurred mid-step in the background
people walking past out of focus behind
a cyclist passing as a soft blur behind
clutter: scooters parked along the kerb, half out of frame
a shop sign cut off by the top of the frame
a delivery van partly out of frame in the distance
ground: worn, stained paving tiles with grime in the joints
scuffed pavement with old gum marks and faded stains
uneven paving with a cracked tile and dust in the corners

cafe.label: Cafe / restaurant
passers: a server turning away out of focus behind
other customers chatting, blurred, at a table behind
someone queuing at the counter, out of focus
clutter: a phone charger trailing across the next table
a crumpled receipt by the sugar jar
a menu card propped crookedly against the wall
ground: a table top with faint cup rings and a few crumbs
a worn floor with scuff marks by the chair legs

kitchen.label: Kitchen
passers: someone moving out of focus at the far counter
a family member's arm reaching into frame, blurred
clutter: a tea towel hanging crooked off the oven handle
a phone charging by the kettle
an open packet left on the counter behind
ground: a countertop with a faint water mark and a few crumbs
a floor tile with a scuff by the cupboard

home.label: Living room / bedroom
passers: someone walking past in the doorway behind, out of focus
a TV glowing softly out of focus in the background
clutter: a remote and a charging cable on the side table
a folded blanket slumped over the armrest
a pair of shoes kicked off by the door
ground: a rug with a slightly flattened, worn patch
floorboards with small scuffs and dust along the skirting

office.label: Office
passers: a colleague walking past out of focus behind
someone on a call at a desk behind, blurred
clutter: a tangle of cables behind the monitor
sticky notes curling at the edge of the screen
a half-finished cup of coffee left on the next desk
ground: a desk with faint mug rings and a scratched edge
carpet tiles slightly worn by the chair

park.label: Park / garden
passers: a jogger passing out of focus behind
people sitting on a bench far behind, blurred
a dog walker crossing in the distance, out of focus
clutter: a bin and a lamppost cut off at the edge of the frame
a bicycle leaning against a railing behind
ground: patchy grass worn down to dirt in places
a gravel path with scattered leaves and footprints

beach.label: Beach
passers: people walking along the waterline, out of focus
a child running past far behind, blurred
clutter: a towel and a pair of flip-flops left behind
a parasol partly out of frame
ground: sand churned with footprints, a few shells and bits of seaweed
damp sand with uneven footprints leading away

shop.label: Shop / supermarket
passers: a shopper pushing a trolley out of focus behind
someone browsing the shelves behind, blurred
clutter: a price label hanging slightly askew on the shelf
a stack of baskets by the door, cut off by the frame
ground: a shiny shop floor with trolley-wheel scuffs
a mat by the entrance with dusty footprints

station.label: Station / transport
passers: commuters hurrying past out of focus
someone dragging a suitcase past, blurred
clutter: a departures board cut off at the top of the frame
a bin overflowing slightly by the pillar
ground: a platform floor with worn yellow edge markings and grime
scuffed floor tiles with old footprints

bar.label: Bar / pub
passers: people talking at the bar behind, out of focus
a bartender reaching for a bottle behind, blurred
clutter: a few empty glasses left on the counter
a beer mat curled at one corner
ground: a sticky-looking counter with wet glass rings
a worn wooden bar top with scratches and dents

laugh.human: caught a split second after laughing, eyes still creased, the smile just starting to fade

turn.human: caught mid-turn, hair still swinging back into place
turn.animal: caught mid-turn of the head, ears still swivelling

walk.human: caught mid-step, one heel just lifting off the ground, clothes swinging with the stride
walk.animal: caught mid-stride, one paw lifted off the ground

drink.human: caught just as the cup leaves the lips, a little steam still between them
drink.animal: caught mid-lap, the tongue just touching the surface, tiny ripples spreading

eat.human: caught mid-bite, a few crumbs just falling

stare.human: caught in a quiet unguarded second, eyes fixed on something just out of frame
stare.animal: caught in a still, intent stare, ears angled forward, whiskers slightly tensed

play.human: caught at the top of the movement, a blur at the hands
play.animal: caught mid-pounce, a paw blurred with motion, tail flicked up

yawn.human: caught mid-yawn, eyes squeezed half shut
yawn.animal: caught mid-yawn, teeth and curled tongue showing, eyes squeezed shut

sleep.human: a slow breath just leaving, lips slightly parted in sleep
sleep.animal: a paw twitching in a dream, whiskers flickering

talk.human: caught mid-word, the mouth half open, a hand blurred mid-gesture

pour.human: caught mid-pour, the stream of liquid frozen in the air
pour.object: caught mid-pour, the stream frozen in the air, a few drops scattered
pour.animal: caught with water droplets frozen mid-air around it

human: caught a split second before a blink, the eyelids just starting to lower
caught as an expression is just changing, mid-way between two looks
a loose strand of hair just lifting in the air
animal: whiskers caught mid-twitch, the tail tip just curling
caught as the head is just tilting
object: a single drop just sliding down its side
a faint wisp of steam or dust just drifting past it
place: a few leaves or bits of litter just drifting in the air
